summary: Iteration 10: Testing POST /api/generate-production-excel endpoint for Balia orders. All 13 backend API tests pass. Frontend UI verified - 'Pobierz techniczny' button in OrdersPage and 'Excel' button in AdminOrdersPage both download Excel files correctly for Balia orders.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/generate-production-excel (lines 336-539 in balia.py) - Generates Excel from template with X marks
Template at /app/backend/templates/production_template.xlsx - Has structure for heater types, colors, models, accessories
Cell mappings: B2=fullName, B4=fullAddress, B10/C10=heater type, D10-R10=fiberglass colors, V10-AB10=acrylic colors, Y16-AD16=models, B16-V16=accessories, B18=notes
OrdersPage.jsx handleDownloadPDF (lines 139-191) - For balia technical type, calls /api/generate-production-excel instead of PDF
AdminOrdersPage.jsx handleDownloadTechnical (lines 161-213) - For balia orders, calls /api/generate-production-excel
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - using existing orders
